{{Quote|My specialty is alien biology, and as a Jedi I recognize that the fundamental unifier of all life is the Force.|Jedi Master Bowspritz, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Jedi Biologist''' was a title granted to [[Jedi Researcher]]s of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who specialized in [[Xenobiologist/Legends|studying]] the [[Xenobiology|biology]] of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[990 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bowspritz]] was a Jedi Biologist. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he [[Author/Legends|authored]] two sections describing various species of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.

==Description==
{{Quote|Jedi Researchers employ their exceptional minds to solve theoretical problems and improve the quality of data in our Archives. Specialists among their ranks include mathematicians, hyperspatial physicists, astronomers, and biologists like the esteemed Master Bowspritz.|Jedi Seer Sabla-Mandibu, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
Jedi Biologist was a title that existed in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="TJP" /> by [[990 BBY]].<ref name="TJP" /><ref name="JPEndnotes1" /> It was granted to members of the [[Jedi Researcher]] rank within the Order's pool of [[Jedi Consular]]s. The bearers of the title specialized in [[Xenobiologist/Legends|researching]] the [[Xenobiology|biology]] of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of various levels of [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] and, similarly to other Jedi Researcher positions, improving the quality of the data stored in the Order's [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="TJP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Xenobiology is a fascinating specialization!|Jedi Master Bowspritz, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
[[File:Star_Wars_The_Jedi_Path_Vault.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jedi Biologist Bowspritz authored two sections for the book ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''.]]
In 990 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the<ref name="TJP" /> [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]]<ref name="JPEndnotes1" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bowspritz]] held the title of Jedi Biologist. Bowspritz, who had also been granted the honorific title of<ref name="TJP" /> [[Jedi Beast Master|Jedi Beastmaster]],<ref name="TJP" /><ref name="JPEndnotes2">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-2.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 2 of 4)}}</ref> was an expert on the aspect of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]],<ref name="FirstLook">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/jedipath/index.html|text=First Look: ''The Jedi Path''}}</ref> and he<ref name="JPEndnotes1" /> found his field of research, xenobiology, to be fascinating.<ref name="TJP" />

Bowspritz went on to [[Author/Legends|author]] two sections for the 990 BBY [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. The first section, placed in the part of the book aimed at Jedi Initiates, served as a brief introduction into the subject matter of xenobiology by highlighting several non-sentient creatures that lived in various habitats across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TJP" />

The second section, addressed to the Order's more advanced [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] students, was composed of three parts, with the first part providing a concise overview of several sentient species widely encountered in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The second part of Bowspritz's Padawan-focused section noted a selection of species that displayed resistance to various [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], and there the Jedi Biologist commented on the [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] [[Shi'ido]] and [[Polydroxol]] being among the most enigmatic species he had encountered in his research. The final section of ''The Jedi Path'' authored by Bowspritz covered a number of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielding]] animal species. Elsewhere in the book, the [[Jedi Seer]] [[Sabla-Mandibu]] noted that Jedi Researchers included [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] such as the "esteemed" Bowspritz.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jedi Biologist Bowspritz: A male Tynnan who gets excited about his area of expertise.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="JPEndnotes1" />}}
The title of Jedi Biologist was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] for the reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']],<ref name="TJP" /> which was first published on [[September 28]], [[2010]]. It was first noted on [[July 18]] of the same year in a [[StarWars.com]] preview for the book.<ref name="FirstLook" />
